body_md:
Yes—these five electrician businesses have Certified Electrical Contractor licenses that a state licensing board lookup shows as Current, Active, each expiring 08/31/2028. Ownership records name an individual owner or officer for each company. Family-owned wording is on file for Doc Watts Electric, Inc. and Moore Electric Company, Inc., and cited Florida filings list no parent company for Moore Electric, Empire Electrical Contractors, LLC, CG Electrical Contractors Corp, and Miller Electrical Services, Inc.

## How we picked

Each business was checked in a state licensing board lookup for trade, license type, license number, status, and expiration. Owner names come from the owner field, and ownership notes come from the company site or Florida filing cited there. Service area, years, hours, payment, offers, other license numbers, addresses, phones, and websites are used only when those fields were present. License facts link to the board page stored as the entry source. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-13.

## At a glance

- All five licenses are Certified Electrical Contractor, Current, Active, expiration 08/31/2028: EC13004296 (Doc Watts Electric, Inc.), EC13009140 (Moore Electric Company, Inc.), EC13008710 (Empire Electrical Contractors, LLC), EC13010246 (CG Electrical Contractors Corp), and EC13005795 (Miller Electrical Services, Inc.).
- Doc Watts Electric lists Central Florida residential, commercial, and industrial work. Moore Electric lists Central Florida commercial, industrial, and institutional work, including medical and dental installations, and also contracts throughout Florida. Empire Electrical Contractors lists Central Florida, including Orlando, Kissimmee, and Sanford, for commercial, office buildings, hotels, schools, multi-family, retail, and warehouse work.
- Addresses on file: 2306 North Forsyth Road, Orlando, FL 32807 (Doc Watts Electric); 2555-D N. Forsyth Rd., Orlando, FL 32807 (Moore Electric); license address 6441 S Chickasaw Trail Suite 320, Orlando, FL 32829 and site office address 651 Danville Dr Ste 102, Orlando, FL 32825 (Empire Electrical Contractors); 1873 Cricket Cradle Drive, Kissimmee, FL 34746 (CG Electrical Contractors); 2153 Premier Row, Orlando, FL 32809, with 15313 Firelight Dr, Winter Garden, FL 34787 also on the license (Miller Electrical Services).
- Years on file: founded 2005 (Doc Watts Electric), since 1985 (Moore Electric), established 2015 (Empire Electrical Contractors), incorporated September 11, 2013 (CG Electrical Contractors), and incorporated May 15, 1984 (Miller Electrical Services).

## Things to know before you go

- Doc Watts Electric lists calls answered 24/7, a $49 whole-home electrical check on its company site, and CFC1428157 on that site along with EC13004296. Listed features include a dedicated generator department, an office and field team, and more than 12,000 square feet of operating space.
- Moore Electric lists certified unlimited electrical contractor, bonded and unbonded work, and office, warehouse, manufacturing, restaurant, and retail electrical work.
- Empire Electrical Contractors lists Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, Saturday-Sunday by appointment, and payment by cash or check. It lists a license address and an office address on its site, so use the one that matches your visit.
- Miller Electrical Services lists a Premier Row address in Orlando and a Winter Garden address on the license. Phones on file are 407-243-2278 for Doc Watts Electric and (407) 930-3736 for Empire Electrical Contractors.

## FAQ

### Are these state licenses active?
Yes. The state licensing board lookup linked on each entry lists status Current, Active and expiration 08/31/2028. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-13.

### Who is named on the ownership records?
George A. Rivera III for Doc Watts Electric, Inc., listed as family-owned and family-operated. Daniel E. Moore, President, and Ann Traynham Moore, Treasurer/Secretary, for Moore Electric Company, Inc., whose site says it is family-owned with Moore family members in day-to-day operations. Daniel R. Ortiz, Manager and registered agent, for Empire Electrical Contractors, LLC. Carlos A. Gomez, President and registered agent, for CG Electrical Contractors Corp. Linda Parker Miller, President, for Miller Electrical Services, Inc., with Craig Alan Miller as CEO and licensee, Sandy Miller Gardner as CFO, and Stacy Miller Weibley as Officer. Florida filings for Moore Electric, Empire Electrical Contractors, CG Electrical Contractors, and Miller Electrical Services list no parent company.

### Do hours and payment match across listings?
No. Doc Watts Electric lists calls answered 24/7. Empire Electrical Contractors lists Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-5:00 PM, Saturday-Sunday by appointment, and payment by cash or check. Service-area wording also differs by listing, so compare that field on the entry you are using.
